newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia to build 10 ships for Russian shipper.
newsitem.headline: Croatia to build 10 ships for Russian shipper.

text.p: Croatia will build ten ships for Russian shipper Novoship, in another boost to the country's struggling shipbuilding industry, state news agency HINA reported on Tuesday.
A visiting Novoship delegation headed by general director Leonid Loza met representatives from the five largest Croatian shipyards in Zagreb on Tuesday, the agency said.
Hrvoje Sarinic, head of Croatia's presidential cabinet, was quoted as saying he was pleased "the Russian company has decided to sign a contract for building another ten ships here.
"That's proof of the quality of our shipbuilders," he said.
No details of the new agreement were released.
Novoship had 12 tankers made in Croatia in 1993 and 1994, in a deal worth $360 million.
Croatia's once-powerful shipbuilding sank to its lowest during a 1991 war with minority Serbs but analysts say it is set to recover thanks to its cheap labour and good technology.
